title: US office vacancy rate (percent)

source.name: Moody's Analytics CRE Preliminary Trend Analysis

notes: Snapshots: 2019 pre-pandemic baseline (16.8%); Q4 2023 (19.6%); Q2 2024 (20.1%, first time breaking 20% in Moody's ~50-year data history); Q2 2025 (20.7%); Q1 2026 (21.0%). The prior all-time record was 19.3%, set during the 1986/1991 S&L-crisis office glut.
